name: Carousel
import: import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselPrevious, CarouselIndicators, CarouselNext } from '@theya/shadcn/ui/carousel';
whenToUse: Browsing a set of similar, optional items one or a few at a time: templates, screenshots, product photos.

whenNotToUse.text: Key messages or anything people must see
whenNotToUse.instead: show it on the page — later slides are rarely seen

do.caption: Templates to browse — optional, alike, and many.

dont.caption: Important notices in slides: most people never see slide 2 or 3.
dont.example: <Slides label="Announcements" items={['Price change on May 1', 'Planned downtime Sat', 'New region: Mumbai']} />

a11y: A named region (`aria-label`) with role description “carousel”; each item says its position.
Arrow keys move between slides; Previous/Next are named buttons. No autoplay — or a pause button if you must.

props.name: peek
props.description:
The current slide sits in the middle, its neighbours peek in from the
sides smaller, dimmer and turned slightly away; the effect follows the
drag. Give CarouselItem a basis under 100% (e.g. basis-[72%]). Centers
the slides (`align: 'center'`) unless `opts` says otherwise. No turn
with prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: CarouselPrevious
components.description: On-canvas (inset, never a negative offset) so it can't widen the page below 360px.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render onto the child element instead of a <button> (shadcn/Radix Slot convention).

props.name: badge
props.description:
Count or status pinned to the top-right corner (a BadgeIndicator, sm,
circle). Pass a number/short text (`badge={5}`, `badge="9+"`), or an
object for a dot or another tone: `{ dot: true }`, `{ value: 3, tone: 'info' }`.
Default tone is danger. Not rendered with `asChild`.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description:
What the badge means, read after the button's name ("5 unread",
"new"). The badge itself is aria-hidden — without this, screen
reader users get no count at all. Dev warning when missing.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Renders as a square icon-only button (no label). Provide the icon via leftIcon.

props.name: leftIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label (or the sole icon when iconOnly is set).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of leftIcon and disables the button. Not supported with asChild.

props.name: rightIcon
props.description: Icon rendered after the label.

props.name: softDisabled
props.description:
Soft-disable: looks disabled and ignores clicks/Enter/Space, but stays
in the tab order and keeps receiving hover/focus (uses aria-disabled
instead of the native `disabled` attribute). Use it when the user needs
to find the button and learn WHY it's unavailable — wrap it in a
Tooltip with the reason. `disabled` stays the hard version (removed
from the tab order, no events at all).

props.name: success
props.description:
The action just succeeded: a tick draws itself in place of leftIcon (Kinetics'
Status Pill, MIT). Pair it with a label that says so ("Deployed") and, usually,
`tone="success"`; turn it off again after a moment. Not supported with asChild.

components.name: CarouselIndicators
components.description:
Slide picker for a Carousel's current slide — the "dash" style
(small dot, active one widens into a pill). Must render inside a
<Carousel>; reads position from the same embla api CarouselPrevious/
CarouselNext use, so it stays in sync with drag/swipe/arrow-key
navigation, not just its own clicks. Renders nothing for a single slide.

props.name: variant
props.description: `on-dark` uses white/translucent-white dots for an image or video background; `default` uses the standard surface tokens.
